changes_log.changes: Included CSV overflow columns unnamed_7, unnamed_8, unnamed_9, and unnamed_10 in source_columns for address.full, address.state, and address.postcode, as unquoted commas in CSV rows caused city, state, and postcode values to break across these extra columns. Added null_if to strip placeholder values like 'n/a'. Removed unnamed_7..10 from unmapped list as they are now mapped.

Added 'when' matching conditions to address.postcode and address.state to restrict extraction to records containing valid Australian postcodes and state identifiers respectively. This resolves the 12% postcode and 70% state transform failures caused by international addresses.

Fixed address.full by adding regex_replace transform to remove procurement process terms (e.g. 'Limited Offer Process', 'Selective') originating from unnamed_7 column before collapsing whitespace. Fixed entity.legal_name warning by adding regex_replace and strip transforms to clean trailing hyphens and punctuation.

1) Rebuilt address.full using only 'Supplier Address' to fix text duplication blocking issue. 2) Restricted address.country emission with a condition requiring an Australian state or postcode match, ensuring overseas suppliers are not wrongly mapped as AU. 3) Added mapping for entity.trading_name when 't/a' is present in Supplier Name and stripped 't/a' portions from entity.legal_name. 4) Lowered confidence on entity name fields to reflect 40-character source truncation.

1. Added regex_extract to entity.trading_name to extract only the trading name after 't/a'. 2. Added condition on address.full to prevent emitting full addresses when Supplier Address contains only a 4-digit postcode. 3. Formatted all transform parameters into strict JSON strings in args_json.

1. Corrected regex escaping in entity.trading_name when condition to (?i)\bt/a\b so it correctly matches 't/a' rows.
2. Removed over-restrictive when conditions on address.postcode and address.state, allowing au_postcode and au_state transforms to run cleanly across address columns.
3. Updated address.country when condition regex to correctly match Australian states/territories or 'Australia' without double-escaping issues.
4. Restricted address.full source_columns to Supplier Address only per reviewer feedback.
